summary: Portland General Electric filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing submission of its 2026 Clean Energy Plan and Integrated Resource Plan to the Oregon Public Utility Commission under Docket LC 88. The plans lay out two resource pathways: one adding 3,377 MW by 2030 and over 5,000 MW by 2032, the other adding 6,747 MW by 2030 and over 9,000 MW by 2032 to meet HB 2021 targets. No transaction, price, or board recommendation is stated; the filing also floats advocacy for a future holding-company structure. Watch the OPUC review timeline for capital and structure implications.
